articulation.alt: brother: /b/ → /r/ → /ʌ/ → /ð/ → /ɚ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.

/ð/: Tongue tip at the teeth; add voice.
